title: Fan Bypass Ratio Divergence & Mechanical Vibration Imbalance

telemetry_indicators.sensor_2: Total pressure at LPC outlet drops below 642.0 psia
telemetry_indicators.sensor_8: Physical fan speed displays high standard deviation or low-frequency flutter

root_causes: Fan blade leading edge foreign object damage (FOD) or bird strike deformation
Acoustic lining panel delamination inside the bypass duct
Fan hub blade root lubrication degradation leading to fretting
dispatch_protocol: Visual fan inspection within 10 cycles. Dynamic balancing required if vibration exceeds 1.5 IPS.
inspection_procedure: Step 1: Visual and tactile inspection of all wide-chord titanium fan blades for nicks, dents, or tears.
Step 2: Tap-test acoustic honeycomb liners in bypass duct for voids or disbonding.
Step 3: Measure fan spinner run-out using dial test indicator.
Step 4: Execute on-wing single-plane or two-plane dynamic fan trim balance.
safety_advisories: Install fan blade containment barrier locks during manual windmilling or engine rotation.
